description: Front B (broad catalog), O11 Reactive lane: ported into a single job from tests/jobs-odc/theme-script-resource.json (birth) and tests/jobs-odc/resource-script-lifecycle.json (edit, refactor and deletion), proven in the ODC lane. A UI Flow of its own (IMobileFlow) receives a theme of its own (IMobileTheme with BaseTheme = the module theme and author CSS) and a screen that requires a module Script (RequiredScripts) and uses the theme class; an IResource without bytes (ResourceContent is read-only) is born with DeployAction/TargetDirectory. Then: the resource changes Description, TargetDirectory, DeployAction and Public, with the RefreshState trap (with DeployAction Ignore the TargetDirectory written before is erased; it is written afterwards) and is renamed; the script changes content and is renamed, a successor receives the consumer by replace and only then does the delete pass without force. Differences from ODC: SS11 has no Shareable (Public is the only bit), and the successor has the JavaScript on a single line. The only new message expected is the platform's answer to DeployAction Ignore (UnusedResource), as in ODC. Same scenario, independent results per lane.

expectedMessages.why: Result of the set DeployAction Ignore (op 31), not a defect: the resource has no consumers in the model (it is a file delivered with the app) and in ODC Resource.InnerVerify only emits this message when Referers is empty and DeployAction == Ignore; the O11 creation map (docs/mapa/criar-reactive-ui) already shows UnusedResource on a freshly created IResource.
